checks.title: L9 campaign planning: one model resident at a time, a killed campaign resumes at the next unfinished unit, a unit the runtime could not serve is counted apart from a failed attempt, a task that needed a command is blocked by policy, a work order is run whole or not at all, and a campaign's seed is refused by a packaged build

L9 tier S against the mock, through the launcher: killed mid-run and restarted, Ctrl+C within two seconds with no record of the unit in flight, an unservable model counted apart, one model resident, the repository's files, index, HEAD and refs unchanged

L9 tier A against the mock, in the application: the agent loop on a linked worktree stages an edit that the record holds, a command is denied by campaign policy and counted, a cancel during a task leaves no record and a later run resumes, the worktree is removed and the repository unchanged
